d:
A beautiful romantic conversation expressed through music! “Dil Mein Jo Baatein Hain” from the 1973 film Joshila features the charming on-screen pairing of Dev Anand and Hema Malini. Sung by the legendary duo Kishore Kumar and Asha Bhosle, this delightful melody is composed by R. D. Burman. Its playful romance, soothing tune and timeless musical charm make it a memorable gem from the golden era of Bollywood.
